description: This file contains unit tests for the HeaderValueValidators class, which provides validators for various header value types in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes tests for validators handling primitives, JSON arrays, EntityTags, and validation chain traversal.

classes.name: HeaderValueValidatorsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HeaderValueValidators, testing various validator retrievals and validation chain behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that HeaderValueValidators class is immutable.

methods.name: getIntValueValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Tests if the integer validator correctly supports int and Integer types.

methods.name: getLongValueValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Tests if the long validator correctly supports long and Long types.

methods.name: getBooleanValueValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Tests if the boolean validator correctly supports boolean and Boolean types.

methods.name: getJsonArrayValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Ensures the JSON array validator supports JsonArray type.

methods.name: validateStringWithNoOpValidator
methods.description: Verifies that the no-op validator accepts any input without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: validatorChainIsCompletelyTraversedUntilResponsibleValidator
methods.description: Tests that the chain of validators correctly traverses until a validation failure occurs, throwing an exception.
